concepts.definition: Tier-1 member owning bounded steps, transitions, intake, execution units, admission, applicability, output, configurations, roles, context construction and fit, acquisition, activation, evaluation, derived-surface staleness, result refinements, disposition, totality, refinement, licensing, work state, restart, cost, proportionality, closed results and reuse. It uses rather than redefines the objects, core algebra and frame activation outcomes owned by FOUNDATIONS and REFERENCE_FRAME. Its rc.2 RF routes are provenance only.

grounding.quote:
core for admission, activation and steps (§3); it redefines nothing those
members own. A route
written `rc.2 RF #anchor` is into
`stdo://releases/v2.5.1-rc.2/standards/REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md` and is
provenance only.

concepts.label: ACTIVATION

concepts.definition: Activation of one reference frame or one declared active frame configuration on an exact subject. Intake, admission, applicability and activation remain distinct relations even within one invocation.

grounding.quote:
A step is the activation of one reference frame, or one declared active
frame configuration, on an exact subject (REFERENCE_FRAME §1, §11). Its
context is the projection of that activated frame to the actor; the corpus
or the workspace is never the context (P0; RF-002). Intake, admission,
applicability and activation are distinct relations inside the step even
when one invocation performs all of them.

concepts.label: Step

concepts.definition: The projection of an activated frame to its actor, providing an account of current state. It is neither the corpus, the workspace nor the state itself.

grounding.quote:
context is the projection of that activated frame to the actor; the corpus
or the workspace is never the context

An actor's context is an account of the
current state, not the state itself

concepts.label: Actor context

concepts.definition: The material workspace and its authoritative inputs, together with justifiable knowledge and explicit unknowns. Its account includes relevant external observations acquired through their owning interfaces and can be incomplete or stale; the workspace remains the subject. Construction denotes this state by A.

grounding.quote:
The current state is the material state of the workspace and
its authoritative inputs, together with what is justifiably known about
that state, with the unknowns explicit.

an actor's
acquired account can be incomplete or stale, and the workspace, not the
account, is the subject

concepts.label: Current state A

concepts.definition: An owner-defined predicate over realised states: the selected outcome, its acceptance conditions and governing obligations. Several states may satisfy it. Construction denotes it by Z; the governing specification, comprising the selected WHAT across Intent, Product and Specification, supplies it and descriptions refine it.

grounding.quote:
The destination is defined by constraints: the selected outcome with its
acceptance conditions (Outcome U, [FOUNDATIONS §2](FOUNDATIONS.md#2-ontology))
and the governing obligations the work must keep. It names no single
state: its acceptance conditions admit several realised states. Its
owning authority defines it (P2, P6).

The
governing specification, the selected WHAT across the Intent, Product and
Specification of the Product that owns the work, supplies Z; its
descriptions refine Z.

concepts.label: Destination Z

concepts.definition: A bounded change from current state to next state, carried out by one step. Work exceeding one activation is refined into a series of such transitions; work fitting one activation is one transition. Each binds the applicable outer obligations of the destination and affected governing relations.

grounding.quote:
A transition is a bounded change from the current state to a next state,
carried out by one step. Where the work exceeds one activation's capacity,
the outer transformation towards the destination is refined into a series
of bounded transitions under §4 Refinement, each carried out by its own
step; work that fits one activation is a single transition.

concepts.label: Transition

concepts.definition: The corpus-owned relation binding A and Z, selecting work and strategy, composing steps, using feedback and claiming completion. Its subject accounts are distinct: specification states required conditions; observations state what holds; a causal or predictive model explains possible state changes. A composition boundary connects one step's output to the next starting state and differs from a categorical join between categories. Feedback observes, compares, diagnoses, selects an authorised response, acts and observes again. Homeostasis is correction toward requirements, without guaranteed convergence or requirement adequacy.

grounding.quote:
This subsection states the construction relation for this corpus: how a
selected construction binds its current state and destination, chooses
its work, composes its steps, corrects itself and claims completion.

The specification is the internal reference model of the required
conditions. Observations describe what does hold. A causal or
predictive model explains how an action may change the state.

Homeostasis
means correction towards the required conditions as disturbances and new
observations arise; it guarantees neither convergence nor the adequacy of

concepts.label: Construction relation

concepts.definition: An arrangement of admissible construction and assurance serving Z within a selected resource envelope. Selection belongs to the realisation and actor exercising admitted work authority. Context limits what one activation can hold; attention limits what it can use; a frame selects one step's material and task contract while Z persists across activations.

grounding.quote:
A strategy arranges admissible construction and assurance to
serve Z within the selected resource envelope.

concepts.label: Strategy

concepts.definition: The step's reconstructable governing input: governed outcome, admitted prerequisite or experiment; exact subject, basis and acquirable inputs; evaluation and result algebra; bounded affected relations and invariants; accepted transformation-admission relations; shared computational dispositions and bindings; construction, assessment and decision authorities and grant; actor capability envelopes; stale, scope and re-entry conditions; and, for a cost claim, allowance and spend measurement.

grounding.quote:
A step is activated from an intake sufficient to reconstruct its governing
relations without conversation history, commentary or a prior actor's memory
(P0, actor-change premise). The intake names:

- where the governed question is a cost claim, the allowance and how
  spend will be measured (§6).

concepts.label: Intake

concepts.definition: The smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable of delivering working behaviour while preserving every affected governing relation. It need not coincide with a function, file, module, ticket field or design document. It supplies the context-construction seed set Z, whose meaning differs from destination Z; context is its projection.

grounding.quote:
The execution unit is the smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable
of delivering working behaviour while preserving every affected governing
relation.
The cone is the seed set Z of §2; the context is its projection.

concepts.label: Execution unit

concepts.definition: A step contract has at least drafted, admitted, rejected and superseded states. Admission is distinct from drafting and validates the exact contract against its cited outcome, prerequisite or experiment basis; it does not admit that basis or create or renew unadmitted authority. An admitted contract identifies a durable result and evidence surface.

grounding.quote:
Drafting a step's contract and admitting it are distinct relations, even
inside one invocation that drafts, validates, admits and executes; no
separate turn, carrier or approval ceremony is implied by the distinction.
A contract carries at minimum the states drafted, admitted, rejected and
superseded

concepts.label: Contract and admission

concepts.definition: Evaluation of the predicate that an obligation applies to the exact subject, determined by the owning evaluation and scope declarations using sufficient basis-bound facts. True maps to satisfied; false maps to falsified with its basis-bound counterexample; a missing or ambiguous premise maps to indeterminate, or out_of_frame when a needed relation is undeclared. Exclusion is the obligation's state after falsified applicability, not a result of that obligation and not a core value. An owner-declared disjunction including non-application has its own predicate.

grounding.quote:
An exclusion is the state of the excluded obligation after a
`falsified` applicability result: it is no result, the obligation's own
evaluation is not performed and maps to no core value, and the obligation
leaves the required coverage of a dependent conjunction under the cited
authority of that applicability result. An obligation whose applicability is
unresolved stays in that required coverage.

concepts.label: Applicability and exclusion

concepts.definition: A candidate together with step-produced facts: judgments and evidence, residuals, observations, authority decisions, provenance and one construction-availability stop state. The actor's internal path is neither output nor governed work.

grounding.quote:
The step's output is a candidate plus its step-produced facts: judgments with
their evidence, residuals, observations, authority decisions, provenance, and
one stop state, a value of construction availability (§3). The actor's
internal path is not part of the output
and is not governed

concepts.label: Step output

concepts.definition: Allocation of task responsibilities and information exchanges to frames spanning the task's work; activation binds actors to frames. An active frame configuration is the part used for one evaluation or decision. Allocation derives from operations, dependencies, available actor capabilities and required assurance, without being uniquely determined. A coordinator, when delivery management is separated from bounded changes, retains the longer-term outcome. The optional executive example assigns construction to Worker/Writer, assessment to Reviewer, and next-work selection and disposition within grant to a non-mutating Executive.

grounding.quote:
A configuration allocates a task's responsibilities and information
exchanges to frames; activation binds an actor to each frame (§2). It
spans the task's work.

That profile owns its frames, their grants, limits and
prohibitions, and its explanation; they apply where it is selected. It is
not the method's default.

concepts.label: Configuration

concepts.definition: Roles are configuration-allocated relations over steps, not actor kinds or a fixed inventory. Where present, constructor owns bounded implementation and self-review, assessor independently evaluates a frozen candidate, and decision owner disposes. A bounded proxy is a delegation whose authority relation determines whether it may accept and advance routine actions.

grounding.quote:
Roles are relations over steps that a configuration allocates
(Configuration above), not kinds of actor and not a fixed inventory.
Where a configuration's operations include construction, assessment or
disposition, this member names the responsibility for each: a
constructor owns the bounded implementation and its self-review; an
assessor evaluates a frozen candidate independently; a decision owner
disposes.

concepts.label: Roles and bounded proxy

concepts.definition: Source-defined procedure taking seed set Z, dependency relation family R and actor envelope B: compute exact finite unique material closure, project with boundary seams, measure and test context fit when capacity is declared, then acquire exact declared inputs. R includes dependencies whose change can alter result, basis validity, evidence sufficiency or authority. Activation binds a reusable frame or active configuration to exact subject and basis and loads its declared material and evidence sources.

grounding.quote:
Given a seed set Z (the subject, outcome and affected relations named in the
intake), a relation family R (the dependency relations whose change can
alter the result, basis validity, evidence sufficiency or authority), and
the actor's envelope B:

concepts.label: Context construction and activation

concepts.definition: Read-only observation of the frame, subject and declared inputs within intake permission. Acquisition is neither admission nor a further actor stage and grants no role, operation or decision.

grounding.quote:
Acquisition is the read-only observation of the material a
step needs (its frame, its subject and its declared inputs) within the
inputs its intake permits it to acquire (§1 Intake). It is not an admission and not a further
actor stage; effectful work still needs its admitted contract (§1
Admission), and acquiring material grants no role, operation or decision

concepts.label: Acquisition

concepts.definition: Material copied, projected or compressed from named owning sources, such as a projected frame or a task constraint surface from a current a_c interpretation. It owns no determination. Currentness is relative to every named source identity in a selected basis, and is separate from fidelity and question-specific sufficiency.

grounding.quote:
A derived surface is material derived from owning
sources by copying, projection or compression, such as a projected frame
for a task; it names its sources and owns no determination.

Matching source identities establish only that the surface was derived
  from those sources. They establish neither its fidelity to them nor its
  sufficiency for a question

concepts.label: Derived surface

concepts.definition: A rendered contract over typed authority, projecting the material selected through acquisition; it is not source law.

grounding.quote:
A prompt is rendered contract over typed authority;
it is not source law.

concepts.label: Prompt contract

concepts.definition: Each performed evaluation returns one core value with its predicate and domain outcome; an unperformed evaluation has no result. Five distinct refinements answer whether a step may begin, whether a candidate is available, whether a candidate is accepted at its declared boundary, whether an ambiguity is resolved on the exact basis, and whether an intended external effect occurred.

grounding.quote:
each evaluation it
performed returns one core value with its predicate and domain outcome,
and an evaluation it did not perform has no result.

concepts.label: Step results and five refinements

concepts.definition: For the predicate 'the step is lawfully admitted and activated on the exact subject and basis': activated maps to satisfied when contract admission has evidence, Z/R/required-edge semantics/basis/scope are exact, closure is finite and unique, projection supplies selected context and frame activation returns activated_frame; admission_refused(authority) maps to out_of_frame for unadmitted work authority or unavailable/unauthorised durable evidence surface and names the missing authority or surface and owner; admission_refused(basis) maps to invalid_basis when the cited outcome/prerequisite/experiment or named subject/basis cannot support the contract; closure_unresolved maps to invalid_basis for inexact closure inputs, nonfinite/nonunique closure or projection gap/refusal and names failed condition and basis coordinates; out_of_frame maps to out_of_frame for an undeclared required relation/capability in all available frame/actor pairings or no fitting context option; activation_refusal retains the cause-specific mapping owned by REFERENCE_FRAME §5.

grounding.quote: | `activated` | the contract is admitted with its admission evidence (§1), Z, R, the required-edge semantics, the basis and the scope are exact and the material closure is finite and unique (§2, step 1), its projection returns a selected context (§2, step 2), and activation returns `activated_frame` | satisfied |

concepts.label: Admission and activation outcomes

conditions: Lawful activation occurred.
concepts.definition: Availability of a constructing step's exact constructed candidate or an assessing step's closed results. For 'a candidate is available': candidate_ready → satisfied when exact candidate and transition evidence exist; refused → falsified when a governing prohibition or owner-valid construction refusal defeats construction, with that prohibition/refusal as counterexample; incomplete → falsified when the step stops without output because a needed evaluation was unperformed or undecidable on admissible evidence, or bounded execution ended first, with stop basis and residuals naming which; re_entry_requested(authority) → out_of_frame for a needed decision outside grant, naming its owner; re_entry_requested(basis) → invalid_basis when activated basis no longer supports work.

grounding.quote:
| `candidate_ready` | satisfied | an exact candidate and its transition evidence are available |
| `refused` | falsified | lawful activation occurred, and a governing prohibition or an owner-valid construction refusal defeats the requested construction; the prohibition or refusal is the counterexample |
| `incomplete` | falsified | the lawfully activated step stopped without its output, because an evaluation the output needs was not performed or could not be decided on the admissible evidence, or bounded execution ended first; the stop basis is the counterexample, and it and the residuals name which |
| `re_entry_requested(authority)` | out_of_frame | a material decision the step needs lies outside its grant; the value names the owner of that decision |
| `re_entry_requested(basis)` | invalid_basis | the activated basis can no longer support the work |

concepts.label: Construction availability

conditions: A decision owner disposes an assessed candidate.
concepts.definition: Acceptance result, distinct from and consuming availability and assessment. For 'the candidate is accepted at its declared boundary': accept → satisfied when the candidate closes its cone and preserves every affected governing relation; local_repair → falsified for locally defective implementation or proof with coherent governing relation; re_enter → invalid_basis when governing outcome, requirement, identity, lifecycle, authority, public contract or accepted design must change; reject → falsified for a violated governing relation or undisposed competing truth path. Assessor recommendations are evidence, never dispositions.

grounding.quote:
| `accept` | the candidate closes its declared cone and preserves every affected governing relation | satisfied |
| `local_repair` | implementation or proof is locally defective while the governing relation remains coherent | falsified |
| `re_enter` | the governing outcome, a requirement, an identity, a lifecycle, an authority, a public contract or the accepted design must change | invalid_basis |
| `reject` | the candidate violates a governing relation or leaves an undisposed competing truth path | falsified |

concepts.label: Candidate disposition

conditions: An ambiguity is declared.
concepts.definition: For 'the declared ambiguity is resolved on the exact basis': resolved → satisfied for a recorded decision under policy permitting lawful probabilistic processing or human adjudication; carried → falsified when policy permits continuation with known open ambiguity, retained as residual naming resolving evidence/decision; escalated → out_of_frame when policy or risk appetite reserves the decision to human authority the step lacks, naming that authority; blocked → falsified when policy or hard stop halts at the known open ambiguity, naming the halting condition and what lifts it.

grounding.quote:
| `resolved` | satisfied | a decision was taken under the policy that permits lawful probabilistic processing, or by human adjudication, and recorded |
| `carried` | falsified | policy permits work to continue with the ambiguity open; the open ambiguity is the counterexample, and it stays a recorded residual that names the evidence or decision that would resolve it |
| `escalated` | out_of_frame | policy or risk appetite reserves the decision to human adjudication, an authority the step does not hold; the value names that authority |
| `blocked` | falsified | the ambiguity stays unresolved, and policy or a hard stop (§4) halts work at it; the open ambiguity is the counterexample, and the value names the halting condition and what would lift it |

concepts.label: Ambiguity outcome

conditions: An effectful step has an intended external effect.
concepts.definition: For 'the intended effect occurred', meaning its declared outcome is attained: completed → satisfied only when subject evidence establishes full occurrence and that the effect ended; not_effected → falsified when subject evidence establishes the outcome is unattained and no later completion can attain it, naming any part that occurred; completion_unknown → indeterminate when neither is established, including lost response without counterexample or full apparent occurrence while the effect may still act. Unknown outcome records the observation that would decide it. Ending is a separate question: evidence must establish the effect no longer acts or never began. Uncertain completion includes completion_unknown and not_effected with unestablished end.

grounding.quote: | `completed` | satisfied | evidence about the subject establishes that the intended effect occurred in full and that the effect has ended |

An effect of uncertain completion is one whose value is
`completion_unknown`, or whose value is `not_effected` with its end not
established.

concepts.label: External effect outcome and end

concepts.definition: Total handling declares next moves for every admitted condition class, including an explicit unknown class, without claiming universal condition recognition, provider termination or request completion. Hard stops override ambiguity risk appetite. Reconfiguration is cause-directed response to out_of_frame, invalid_basis, repeated indeterminate or incompatible results.

grounding.quote:
Each admitted condition class has a declared
next move, including an explicit unknown class. Total handling does not
claim that every external condition is recognised, that an invoked provider
terminates, or that every request can be completed.

concepts.label: Totality, hard stops and reconfiguration

concepts.definition: Refinement decomposes an outer transformation T: A → X into typed steps connecting success predicates P₀ … Pₙ. A rewrite replaces a representation, step or composite with another claimed to preserve meaning, including partition, regrouping, reordering, merging or substitution. Exact steps preserve meaning under the subject's declared interpretation; approximate steps require an adequacy relation and an argued composite end-to-end bound. A licensing law is an owner-declared law permitting a refinement or rewrite.

grounding.quote:
An outer transformation T: A → X with success predicates P₀ … Pₙ
is faithfully refined by steps Tᵢ when each admitted input satisfying Pᵢ
yields an output satisfying Pᵢ₊₁, retains every applicable invariant, exposes
other outcomes without coercion, and each output satisfies the next step's
declared domain and preconditions

A rewrite step replaces a representation, a step or
a composite by another that is claimed to keep its meaning, for example
by partitioning, regrouping, reordering, merging or substituting parts.

concepts.label: Refinement, rewrite and licensing

conditions: A material transition is being admitted.
concepts.definition: Each admission owner's independent derivation and validation of the complete enclosing relation from authoritative inputs. The relation includes every participant and equality join whose identity, validity, authority, currentness or transition can affect or be affected by admission. Admission is one semantic commit of the complete transition on its exact authoritative basis, or none.

grounding.quote:
For a material transition, each admission owner is independently
responsible for deriving and validating the complete enclosing relation
from authoritative inputs

Admission
is one semantic commit of the complete transition, bound to its exact basis
identity; failure or interruption admits the complete transition or none,
never a subset.

concepts.label: Complete enclosing-relation admission

conditions: Admission owners and supported boundaries are declared by accepted design.
concepts.definition: Qualification of the admission law for every such owner and boundary, with case applicability determined by supported input, state and operating or threat model. It covers direct and supported composite/nested forms, forgery, enclosing-relation ambiguity, stale/advanced and incoherent multi-owner bases, competing authority, reconstruction, exact replay and post-validation atomic publication failure.

grounding.quote:
Qualification of the admission law is instantiated for every admission
owner and supported boundary declared by accepted design

concepts.label: Standing structural qualification

concepts.definition: Persistent object comprising current workspace, governing basis, applicable closed results and judgments with invalidators, residuals and known uncertainty over external effects. Carrier choice belongs to profile or realisation; resumption, checkpoints and progress accounting require no particular carrier. Resumption re-enters the same method over current material state, possibly with another actor. Acceptance checkpoints bind exactly accepted work; preservation checkpoints may retain unfinished or unaccepted work without acceptance, promotion or publication.
concepts.label: Work state, resumption and checkpoints

concepts.definition: Semantic categories: progress is accepted material movement toward the selected outcome; prerequisite work names the enabled obligation; preservation and repeated proof are evidence rather than new progress; rejected or superseded construction is churn; discovery of hidden distance revises forecast rather than creating negative progress. These categories are not a numerical progress algorithm.

grounding.quote:
Progress is accepted material movement toward the selected outcome;
prerequisite work names the obligation it enables; preservation and
repeated proof are evidence, not new progress; rejected or superseded
construction is churn; discovering previously hidden distance revises the
forecast and is not negative progress.

concepts.label: Progress, prerequisites, evidence, churn and forecast revision

concepts.definition: Source-authored foundation-to-law traces distinguish standing, instance premises, consequences, owner choices and consumers. P0 is recovered; P1, P2, P3, P4a and P6 are independent; P4b derives from P0/P2 with the non-reacquirability premise for step-produced facts; P5 derives from P0/P6 with the open-world premise. Transition-family premises are a selected outcome with acceptance conditions, possibly multi-activation work, actors with declared capability envelopes, and an admitted grant. Work-state-family premises are persistent workspace, work spanning activations, actors that may change, and external effects in an open world. These are work conditions, not commitments or consequences of finite capacity alone.

grounding.quote:
They are conditions of the work this family governs,
not commitments, and do not follow from finite capacity alone.

Its instance premises are: (a) a workspace that
persists across activations; (b) work that spans activations; (c) actors
that may change between activations; (d) external effects in an open
world. They are conditions of the work this family governs, not
commitments, and do not follow from finite capacity alone.

concepts.label: Foundation-to-law trace

conditions: Construction is delegated to a probabilistic or agentic worker.

grounding.quote:
The
normative relation runs: accepted governing basis; bounded affected
relation set; selected computational relations; delegated execution and
decision authority; construction and self-review; independent live-surface
assessment where required; one of accept, local repair, re-enter or reject
(§3); the exact accepted checkpoint; the next already-authorised bounded
action (§5).

constraints.statement: The described execution relation proceeds from accepted governing basis through bounded affected relations, selected computational relations, delegated execution/decision authority, construction and self-review, independent live-surface assessment where required, semantic disposition, exact accepted checkpoint and next already-authorised bounded action. Consumers apply the owning rules without making additional decisions those owners do not make.

grounding.quote: | Premises, with standing | Consequence that follows | Rule in this member that states it | Added domain or policy choice, and its owner | Pillar |
| Premises, with standing | Consequence that follows | Rule in this member that states it | Added domain or policy choice, and its owner | Pillar |

constraints.statement: Preserve the source's premise associations, using a–d separately within each family. Transition family: transitions ← P0,P2;a,b; intake/admission/output ← P0,P4b,P6;d; applicability ← P1,P6,P5;a; configuration/delegation ← P0,P2,P4a,P5,P6;b,c,d; recording without review ← P6,P2,P0;d; completion/change/stops ← P2,P6,P4b,P5;a; totality/hard stops ← P5,P2,P6;d; refinement ← P4a,P1,P6;b; complete admission/qualification ← P4b,P3,P6;d; A/Z/accounts ← P2,P3,P1,P6;a; strategy ← P0,P2,P5,P6;b,c; composition ← P4a,P1,P6;b; feedback ← P1,P2,P6,P5;a; preservation/progress/completion ← P5,P2,P6;a,b. Work-state family: state object ← P3,P0;a,b; workspace/account ← P0,P3,P4b,P6;a,c; uncertain effects ← P5,P6;d; checkpoint/progress ← P2,P6;b; handoff/reuse ← P4b,P0,P6;c; transition evidence ← P5,P6;c. These are authored derivation claims, not proofs supplied by this interpretation.
constraints.uncertainty: The underlying FOUNDATIONS account of standing is referenced but not supplied.

grounding.quote:
A new observation may add obligations,
which join the known work, or invalidate a claim, which is re-established
or withdrawn before anything relies on it

The work state (§5) retains the unresolved outcome, the residuals and the
obligations still owed. A stop reaches no destination and discards none
of these

constraints.statement: Transitions compose only under refinement. Intake binds current state through exact subject/basis, destination or prerequisite through governed outcome, and preserved obligations through affected relations/invariants. Discovery can add obligations and enlarge known work; invalidated claims must be re-established or withdrawn before reliance. Obligations outside current attention remain open, and the next decision retains material dependencies on them. Authorised destination changes follow the owner and re-enter the owning relation; revised satisfaction proves nothing about former satisfaction. Completion requires sufficient evidence that current state satisfies applicable destination and acceptance conditions, with acceptance belonging to the decision owner; empty lists, counts and absence of recorded counterexamples do not establish it. Inability to continue causes an explicit cause-named stop: unavailable output takes non-candidate_ready availability; halting/out-of-authority ambiguity takes blocked/escalated; refused admission/activation creates no step. Stops retain outcome, residuals and debts. Progress uses outcome evidence, not remaining-item count. Intake and work state already carry the bindings; no further carrier is required.

grounding.quote:
A
lawful construction can remain incomplete or fail to reach Z, and
lawfulness establishes neither delivery nor optimality.

a claim about one is never taken for a claim about
another, and the applicability and adequacy of a predictive model are
claims of their own

constraints.statement: Construction explicitly binds A and Z. Applicable declared requirements and tenant calculi govern lawful transformations/compositions but select no outcome. Lawfulness proves neither delivery nor optimality; outcome proofs retain their premises and scope. Specification, observations and predictive models remain different accounts, each possibly incomplete or wrong; claims do not transfer among them, and model applicability/adequacy need their own support. The path may be discovered during work and evaluation. This subsection alone owns the construction relation; consumers apply it at construction, triage, recovery, assurance and release. Domain strategy, configuration, execution mechanisms and added assurance retain their owners. Existing work/evidence carriers suffice; the relation establishes no independent ledger, required role sequence, runtime, general solver, fixed organisation, guaranteed convergence or categorical universality theorem.

grounding.quote:
Measures that justify a choice state
their units, boundaries and composition rules, and keep estimates,
assumptions and observations distinguishable.

constraints.statement: Material strategy choices account for context, attention, time, effort, computation, communication and other relevant resources, feedback delay, uncertainty, integration exposure and rework; planning/checking/coordination also consume resources. Justifying measures state units, boundaries and composition rules and distinguish estimates, assumptions and observations. Owning criteria decide tradeoffs when multiple objectives leave alternatives incomparable. Record material rationale in existing design/work records. Superiority claims state objectives, comparison and assumptions.

grounding.quote:
Steps
compose through compatible preconditions, effects, results and authority,
and each boundary preserves the applicable outer obligations.

constraints.statement: Every composition boundary preserves applicable outer obligations and requires compatible preconditions, effects, results and authority. Decomposition, delegation, concurrency and recursion retain affected obligations. Refinement may add detail and construction may change state only within permitted variation. Independent actions may run concurrently when dependencies, effects and authority permit. Local success establishes end-to-end success only with required coverage, compatibility and outcome evidence. Categorical construction claims require the demonstration owned by FOUNDATIONS §4.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced chain obligations and categorical demonstration are not fully supplied.

grounding.quote:
Diagnosis distinguishes four causes: a defective realisation, an
inadequate governing requirement or design, an inaccurate predictive
model, and insufficient observation.

constraints.statement: Feedback compares current subject observations with governing conditions and routes authorised responses to supported causes: defective realisation, inadequate requirement/design, inaccurate predictive model or insufficient observation. Preserve unresolved alternatives. Prediction error alone does not decide outcome satisfaction; model revision neither erases a counterexample nor repairs realisation by itself. A bug is observed or suspected discrepancy within feature/change work using the same intake/delivery mechanism; its label supplies neither repair class nor permission. Severity describes consequence; priority orders response under outcome, dependencies, resources and authority. A bug list projects existing work state and creates no delivery or authority mechanism.

grounding.quote:
Recursive and repeated work
distinguish four claims: preservation, that an invariant or obligation is
kept through the steps; progress, that the work moves towards Z on
evidence; termination; and outcome satisfaction.

Producing a candidate, proving a property and accepting delivery remain
distinct acts

constraints.statement: Preservation, progress, termination and outcome satisfaction each require their own support. Formal induction/termination claims supply premises and argument; no universal termination proof is prerequisite to bounded work, and absent proof limits the claim to available evidence. Continuing work has supported purpose under strategy, possibly uncertainty reduction or bounded hypothesis testing; repeated activity alone is not progress. Failure, unavailable information, uncertain effects and exhaustion use the named continuation/repair/recovery/re-entry/yield/stop paths. Resumption reacquires reality and retains valid progress; unknown effects are sufficiently resolved before dependent action. Maintenance may continue under mandate; delivery needs a completion condition. Evaluation preserves failure, missing coverage and uncertainty. Proof, mechanical checks, tests and observed use establish only their respective scoped claims; required but unavailable proof remains an obligation. Candidate production, property proof and acceptance are distinct. Completion requires evidence against Z including acceptance conditions. Exhaustion/unresolved attempts prove neither achievement nor impossibility; changing Z does not resolve former satisfaction or erase the original counterexample.

grounding.quote:
Implementation folklore is not an intake source. Where a design profile
applies, its bounded-frame conservation, transformation-admission
completeness, invariant-reconstruction sufficiency and
computational-realisation projection laws supply the affected set, the
admission relations, the invariants and the computational dispositions;
this section consumes those laws and creates no second design package

constraints.statement: Intake must reconstruct governing relations without history, commentary or prior memory. Name subject, basis and acquirable inputs by identity and hash or input commit. Name the evaluation/family and core algebra or mapped refinement; affected relations/invariants; accepted transformation admission; shared machinery/binding; applicable frame-set, semantic, evaluation, material operation and decision authorities; grant operations, mutable territory and decisions reserved to others; capability envelopes; invalidation/scope/re-entry conditions; and cost allowance/measurement when the question is a cost claim. Implementation folklore is not a source. Where a design profile applies, its four named conservation/admission/reconstruction/projection laws supply the relevant fields; intake creates no second design package.

exceptions: A seam's far side is excluded when the basis establishes that it cannot causally participate.

grounding.quote:
A seam whose far side can causally affect,
or be affected by, the action is inside the cone unless the basis
establishes that it cannot participate. Unrelated incompleteness outside
the cone is recorded as repricing input and does not block the bounded
claim.

constraints.statement: Include every seam far side that can affect or be affected by the action unless basis-grounded nonparticipation is established. Record unrelated incompleteness outside the cone as repricing input; it does not block the bounded claim.

exceptions: Explicit human override of the exact contract is an alternative to deterministic admission.

grounding.quote:
Execution begins only after deterministic admission or an
explicit human override of the exact contract.

The admitted contract names one
durable result and evidence surface; every result, withheld closure and
residual obligation is recorded there before return, a conversation return
alone is not durable evidence, and if no such surface is authorised and
available, admission refuses

constraints.statement: Execute only after exact-contract admission. The drafting actor cannot infer admission from its draft, carrier, lane or active label or self-certify its execution basis. Admitted result identifies mechanism, authority, exact identity/digest, decision and evidence including override; without those coordinates the contract remains drafted or rejected, and assertion prose is not evidence. Admission validates against but does not admit the cited basis; drafting/admission/retention creates or renews no unadmitted authority. Only an admitted contract activates a step: results, child completion, tool/model output, shared actors and lateral handoffs alone neither activate another step nor authorise continuation; routing profiles name their instances of this rule. Before return record every result, withheld closure and residual obligation on the one authorised available durable surface. Conversation alone is insufficient. Missing/rejected admission returns cause-named admission_refused and missing work authority without execution. Carrier selection remains TICKETS tier-2 law.

grounding.quote:
unresolved applicability withholds the dependent claim until
sufficient evidence or the owning decision resolves it; other applicable
constraints stay in force even if only one evaluation detects them

that `satisfied` is for the declared disjunction only and
never counts toward the predicate that the obligation holds

constraints.statement: True applicability requires the obligation's evaluation/result; false applicability excludes only that obligation under cited authority, recording inapplicability apart from its result and waiving no acceptance criterion. Missing/ambiguous premises are unresolved, never false; they retain required coverage and withhold dependent claims until evidence or owner decision resolves them. Frame names, available tools and listed families do not activate work. Residual semantic judgment and evidence remain judgment, never computed fact. Absent, stale, wrong-subject/basis or incapable required results cannot satisfy dependent conjunctions; other applicable constraints remain effective even if detected once. Under a finite declared fixture, qualification distinguishes true/false/unknown premises, missing/wrong-subject required results and sufficient positive result; always-skip/always-activate rules cannot satisfy those outcomes. Excluded obligations are unperformed and have no core value. Non-application can satisfy only an explicitly declared disjunction, never the obligation-holds predicate. Members/profiles/projects refer to this exclusion rule rather than deciding it again.

grounding.quote:
A configuration is admitted by the smallest
existing authority that owns the material decision the configuration
makes.

A configuration is evaluated against the
task, its dependencies, the actors' limits, the authority it applies and
the required assurance.

constraints.statement: Selecting design explains allocation, material resource limits under §6 and failure assumptions in existing design/frame/work records, proportionally. Direct entry states this in intake through capability envelopes and stale/scope/re-entry conditions; no separate carrier is required. Evaluate task, dependencies, actor limits, authority and assurance; labels/topology/coordinator/familiar roles neither accept nor reject configuration. Preserve all RF-009 relation distinctions without additions/deletions. Naming/selecting frames grants no authority; activation binds subject, algebra, capabilities and admitted authority. Every configuration is admitted by the smallest existing authority owning its material decision; multiple owners retain their decisions and admission creates no authority over them. A bounded proxy admits only within existing grant; owner-to-decision bindings belong to applying method/profile, with the executive binding owned externally.
constraints.uncertainty: RF-009's list and the external executive authority binding are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
Reconfiguration. The allocation, and every reconfiguration, preserves the
material dependencies, the outstanding obligations, the effects,
including those of uncertain completion, the admitted authority and the
required independence. A reconfiguration is any change of allocation
during the work, including actors redistributing work among themselves
and the changes §4 Reconfiguration selects after a result. An outstanding
obligation and the results that depend on it move with the work. An
effect of uncertain completion is resolved sufficiently for the next
dependent action before that action (§3 Effects, §5). Required
independence keeps its authorship and evidence conditions
([EVALUATION §3](EVALUATION.md#3-independent-assessment)), which a fresh
context alone does not meet. An adaptive or self-organised arrangement is
exempt from none of these conditions (P4b, P5, P6).

Coordination across tasks. Where a configuration separates carrying out a
bounded change from managing delivery across successive tasks, the frame
that manages delivery, a coordinator, keeps the longer-term outcome. It
decides from a sufficient bounded view of the closed results of the task
frames (§7), not from their working context. When a decision needs
information that view lacks, the coordinator acquires it through its
permitted frame inputs or requests a further bounded evaluation. Missing
information is never assumed favourable. A task result never omits a
blocker material to delivery: a compact result keeps every residual and
stop material to delivery, and its size is no evidence that none exists
(P0, P4b, P6).

Optimality. Adequacy and optimality are separate claims. A claim that a
configuration is optimal is relative to stated objectives, constraints and
comparison scope, and rests on evidence for that comparison. Familiarity,
persistence or self-organisation is no such evidence. Different
objectives or actor models can favour different configurations (P2, P6).

constraints.statement: Allocation and every reallocation, including actor redistribution and adaptive/self-organised arrangements, preserve dependencies, outstanding obligations, effects including uncertain completion, admitted authority and required independence. Obligations and dependent results move with work. Resolve uncertain effects sufficiently before the next dependent action. Independence retains its authorship/evidence requirements; a fresh context alone is insufficient. Where a coordinator manages delivery across tasks, it decides from sufficient bounded closed results, not task working context, acquiring permitted missing input or requesting bounded evaluation. Never assume missing information favourable. Compact task results retain every delivery-material blocker, residual and stop; size proves no absence. Configuration optimality is separate from adequacy and requires stated objectives, constraints, comparison scope and comparison evidence; familiarity, persistence and self-organisation are insufficient.

grounding.quote:
Where
independent assessment supports promotion, the assessor evaluates the
exact live subject, its authority paths, proof and installed state, not
the constructor's summary

Direct entry preserves
execution-contract admission (Admission above), the smallest lawful
carrier, the required assessment and the reserved decisions; it permits
bounded work and condition-based result recording, not self-acceptance at a
boundary owned elsewhere

constraints.statement: Promotion-supporting independent assessment evaluates exact live subject, authority paths, proof and installed state. Actor count is not prescribed; one actor can occupy roles across different claims only while preserving independence for the assessed claim. Role names confer no operation. A declared proxy may accept preservation, demand local repair, reject violation and advance already-authorised actions within its limit; it cannot override direct human acceptance required by product/release law. Human ceremony need not recur when governing basis, affected cone, decision envelope and re-entry conditions are already accepted. A capable context with sufficient existing authority, exact intake and operation grant may enter directly as constructor without a coordinating appointment. Coordination is selected for material context, authority, capability or independence needs, not names. Direct entry retains admission, smallest lawful carrier, assessment and reserved decisions and permits no self-acceptance at another owner's boundary.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete proxy-limit law remains in the unsupplied FOUNDATIONS authority section.

conditions: Applicable law requires no independent assessment and reserves no acceptance.
The constructor holds the relevant grant.
exceptions: Any actually applicable assessment or reserved acceptance remains required.

grounding.quote:
Recording a result without review. Where the applicable law requires no
independent assessment and reserves no acceptance, the constructor that
holds the grant may record the satisfied bounded result, with the conditions
it found satisfied and their evidence, in the existing durable result
surface

constraints.statement: The constructor may record the satisfied bounded result and evaluated conditions/evidence in the existing durable surface without an added carrier, coordinating appointment, review or recreated design view solely to mark completion. Recording waives no applicable condition, reports no unperformed evaluation and is no disposition at another owner's boundary. Discovered insufficiency withholds the dependent effect and returns the question to its owner. Carriers/profiles refer here and add only their carrier binding.

grounding.quote:
One bounded operation grant may cover its declared construction, status and
checkpoint sequence. Actual role transitions are recorded in the existing
work carrier; a status change alone requires neither a new grant nor
rehashing an unchanged subject.

constraints.statement: One bounded grant may cover its declared construction/status/checkpoint sequence; record actual role transitions in existing carrier. Status change alone needs neither new grant nor rehash of unchanged subject. Resolve materially changed operation, subject, territory, authority or validity binding before effect. A sequence-wide grant does not lift a selected configuration's coordinator mutation prohibition, including the Executive's.

grounding.quote:
If Z, R, the required-edge semantics, the basis or the scope is not
   exact, or the closure is not finite and unique on the exact basis,
   activation returns `closure_unresolved` (§3, Admission and activation)
   and no step proceeds; it does not guess.

constraints.statement: Require exact seed, relation family, required-edge semantics, basis and scope and finite unique closure on that basis; otherwise return closure_unresolved without proceeding or guessing. Project closure while recording excluded, external, unresolved, translated and invalidation-sensitive seams. A projection gap/refusal also returns closure_unresolved without proceeding. Material outside closure stays out; adjacency/existence does not warrant inclusion. The procedure does not require proof that no undiscovered material relation exists.

conditions: The selected actor envelope declares a context capacity.
exceptions: With no declared context capacity, this measurement is not required; other finite-attention conditions still apply.

grounding.quote:
The measurement, the capacity and the
   outcome of the comparison are recorded before the read. A fit holds
   only for the measured boundary

constraints.statement: Before the actor reads selected context, measure its size in the declared capacity unit, bytes or tokens, over the execution binding's declared boundary; record measurement, capacity and comparison. This applies to every governed question with declared capacity, but is not a budget or universal gate. Outside-boundary context is explicitly unmeasured and uncovered. Distinguish bounded measured fit from the step's fit judgment: establish that judgment using recorded complete active inputs or supported upper bound including host context; otherwise indeterminate unless counterexample such as measured excess establishes falsified. A correct task result retains bounded standing but cannot satisfy missing fit judgment. Size establishes only fit; actual-use evidence decides adequate attention. Other envelope dimensions use RF-014 and resource limits use §6.

conditions: Selected context does not fit the actor envelope.
exceptions: The grant/envelope owner may delegate actor selection or envelope enlargement in advance.

grounding.quote:
None of these options silently reduces the required predicate: the
   obligations the step preserves stay bound

constraints.statement: Use one or more of refinement into fitting steps, sequencing, lawful compression preserving material distinctions/failure detections, fitting actor selection, or out_of_frame. Silent omission is forbidden. Obligations remain bound; narrowing them is owner-authorised destination change, and undecided material remains explicit unknown. The step may select refinement/sequencing/compression within grant. Actor change or envelope enlargement re-enters its owner unless already delegated. Record compression and preservation argument; independent assessment is required only where its served promotion requires it.

grounding.quote:
Only material in the exact selected
basis is acquired: where that basis has no derived surface for the task,
its exact owner sections are used, and a candidate source, a version-line
selector or another basis is no substitute for it

A declared input absent
   from the actor's materialised view is neither licence to read elsewhere
   nor evidence that it is absent.

constraints.statement: Acquire declared inputs by exact identity within intake permission. An input missing from materialised view licenses no elsewhere read and proves no absence. Acquire a task-serving derived surface with current sources; for another task or a stale, missing or question-insufficient surface, acquire deciding owner sections declared in the exact selected basis. Candidate sources, version selectors and other bases are no substitutes. Read selected material and actual subject and follow needed material/coupled-obligation references; corpus availability alone warrants no read. Sufficiency is question-specific, never universal for a frame or corpus. Before dependent action, return missing bindings with names: out_of_frame for no available frame declaring the needed relation; admission_refused(basis) or activation_refusal(basis) for absent or unverifiably exact basis. Coupled material that does not fit uses fit remediation.

exceptions: Historical workaround prose may remain in a prompt when a current requirement, design, runtime or test still needs the constraint.

grounding.quote:
A derived surface or projected frame decides standalone
only the questions that its own source members own.

If the prompt needs an
upstream ambiguity resolved, it names the unresolved authority gap before
fallback context is read.

constraints.statement: Actor/assigning authority selects a capable frame or declared configuration. Activation binds exact subject/basis and declared relations/evidence, delivering the referenced frame packet rather than a workspace dump. If no lawful frame/actor pairing exists, return out_of_frame for undeclared material relation/capability, otherwise the applicable activation_refusal; no implied-context continuation. Evaluation applies declared invariants, evidence rules and algebra, distinguishes semantic law, evidence, inference and decision, and records every result-sensitive assumption. A standalone derived surface refuses questions owned elsewhere or joining several owners: return out_of_frame naming owners, then decide from all current owner digests or a derived surface declaring every owner. Prompts project current authority references, obligations, contracts, boundaries, proof expectations and fallback conditions, starting at the highest needed live authority. Exclude obsolete workarounds; name upstream authority gaps before fallback reads and project raw owners when acquisition requires them.

grounding.quote:
It is current for a selected basis only while every source identity it
  names equals the identity of that source in the selected basis. A change
  to any of them makes it stale.

constraints.statement: For every method/carrier, name exact identities, such as path and digest, of every derivation source and every source whose change can alter content. Currentness requires every named identity equal its selected-basis identity; any change makes the surface stale. Never use stale material as current for any question. Restore currentness only through selected-basis regeneration or explicit re-acceptance recording new identities and finding content still matches; meanwhile use deciding owners directly. Matching identities prove neither fidelity nor question sufficiency. Selected-basis owner sections decide insufficiency and overreach; a surface never decides this about itself. Packaging/installation carriers refine identities/re-acceptance procedure and cite this owner; released-carrier binding remains PRODUCT_DEFINITION §11.

grounding.quote:
Each names the question it answers and the
predicate its mapping is for, and maps each of its values to exactly one
core value; the predicate travels with the value, so no refinement's
`satisfied` counts toward another predicate

constraints.statement: Each refinement value maps to exactly one core value for its named predicate, retaining question and domain outcome. Satisfied never transfers to a different predicate. Profiles refining their units must provide the same single-valued mapping and add no core value. Do not conflate refused activation with a step stop, availability with fitness/acceptance, carried ambiguity with resolution, or unknown effect with absence. Unperformed evaluations have no result.

grounding.quote:
A refused admission or activation creates no step, no
activation of the step's frame and no work result

constraints.statement: A step exists only after contract admission and exact-subject/basis frame activation. Cause selects admission/context-construction outcome. Frame-activation causes, predicate and mappings remain owned by REFERENCE_FRAME §5 and are not remapped here. Admission/activation outcomes are neither construction-availability values nor step results. Refusal creates no step, frame activation or work result; it returns to assigning authority or declared carrier and must never be recorded as a step stop.
constraints.uncertainty: The full external frame-activation cause table is unavailable.

conditions: A step was lawfully activated.
exceptions: When both authority and basis cause re-entry, record both and choose re_entry_requested(basis).

grounding.quote:
The mapping is total and exclusive after lawful activation: the cause of
the stop selects the value, and payload wording, stop timing or actor
preference cannot select another.

An assessing step that ends `incomplete` leaves each criterion it did not
evaluate not performed: no result, never `falsified`.

constraints.statement: Availability mapping is total/exclusive after lawful activation and selected by cause, not wording, timing or preference. Mismatches known before activation use admission/activation outcomes instead. Availability satisfied establishes no fitness or acceptance. Incomplete is falsified only for candidate availability, never indeterminate; performed evaluations retain their own results including indeterminate when evidence cannot decide. Planned unperformed evaluations have no result and remain work-state residuals naming unfinished capability/execution. An incomplete assessor does not falsify unassessed criteria or the subject. Re-entry cause is part of the value to preserve single-valued mapping; an unusable basis takes precedence over an authority deficit.

grounding.quote:
Repeated rejection against one unchanged boundary
requires reassessment of the frame altitude, the causal cone, the common
components, the design-versus-code placement and the authority
sufficiency.

constraints.statement: Local defect counters local acceptance; violated relation or competing truth path counters rejected acceptance. A repair creates a new candidate with its own results. Re_enter means the construction/assessment basis cannot support acceptance and change re-enters its owner. Global correctness conserves every affected global relation, not proof of the entire Product in every local action. Repeated rejection at unchanged boundary requires reassessing frame altitude, causal cone, common components, design/code placement and authority sufficiency. No count threshold, mandatory review rounds or review state machine is prescribed; repeating the unchanged failed relation as though iteration alone closes it is prohibited.

grounding.quote:
An open ambiguity is a known state of the exact basis, so `carried` and
`blocked` decide the predicate false; neither is `indeterminate`, whose
evidence cannot decide the predicate.

constraints.statement: Record every ambiguity outcome. Known open ambiguity falsifies resolution for carried/blocked; it is not evidence-undecidable indeterminate. Carry resolving evidence/decision or halting/lifting conditions with the domain outcome. Only resolved maps to satisfied; no dependent claim may treat carried, escalated or blocked as resolved.

grounding.quote:
The end never decides a
`not_effected` value and is never folded into one

A lost response, an
absent record, or an actor's context that holds no trace of the effect is
not that evidence, and the value stays `completion_unknown`.

constraints.statement: Not_effected requires subject evidence of unattained and no-longer-attainable declared outcome: examples include never begun, ended short, a bounded interval closed partly undone, or prior action destroying something required. Name partial effects. Lost response, missing record or absent contextual trace does not establish it; completion_unknown remains indeterminate and never becomes completed/not_effected by relabelling. End is a separate conjunct required only for completed. If begun effect lacks evidence of ending, retain a residual naming deciding observation alongside its outcome. Not_effected may coexist with continued action; its counterexample and end residual neither erase nor weaken each other. Before repetition or dependent action, reconcile uncertain completion sufficiently for that action. Not_effected licenses neither treating the effect as absent nor repeating it while its end is unestablished.

grounding.quote:
Hard stops. Some conditions are not optional ambiguity decisions and
remain hard stops regardless of risk appetite.

A hanging external call,
an unsatisfiable demand and a lost post-effect response are three different
cases and none is solved by adding a value to the algebra.

constraints.statement: Name next moves in advance after every non-satisfied result: supported continuation within contract, refinement, recovery, yield, owner re-entry or termination, including unknown condition class. Distinguish hanging provider, unsatisfiable demand and lost post-effect response; extra algebra values solve none. Applicable ambiguity policy/risk appetite chooses ambiguity outcome; default policy belongs to SPEC_METHOD §5 and none is set here. Hard stops hold regardless of appetite; typical classes are violated invariant/guarantee, missing required authority surface, missing declared execution/operation capability, undeclared irreversible effect and explicit human-approval gate. They halt at the condition with blocked for declared ambiguity or a transition stop otherwise. For out_of_frame, invalid_basis, repeated indeterminate or incompatible result, follow cause by supplying admissible evidence, selecting another actor within envelope, activating another existing frame, refining/extending a frame, revising frame set, changing evaluation or re-entering Product/method owner. Difficulty alone does not establish need for another frame.
constraints.uncertainty: The source labels hard-stop classes typical, not exhaustive.

exceptions: With no declared subject law, only universally valid steps, valid whatever the subject's laws, are admissible.

grounding.quote:
Coverage of the outer obligations, correctness of the local
implications and legitimate authority are premises, not conclusions; "each
step passed" is weaker than "the outer contract was conserved".

Where
no law is declared for the subject, only universally valid steps are
admissible: steps that hold whatever laws the subject has.

constraints.statement: Faithful refinement requires every admitted Pᵢ input to yield Pᵢ₊₁ output, preserve every applicable invariant, expose other outcomes without coercion and meet the next step's domain/preconditions. Outer coverage, valid local implications and legitimate authority are premises. Required coupled relations fit together in some step; unrelated obligations remain outside context; each affected crossing seam includes its far side or establishes nonparticipation. Nonadjacent output passage requires a declared adapter composed as a step under AC-016 or a specialised contract naming carried material in its domain and declared under its owner's exact authority, context, basis, scope, preservation, loss, refusal and invalidation law. Every layer states and discharges preservation of its parent. Refinement/rewrite requires an applicable declared licensing law or universal validity; an unlicensed non-universal step and composites relying on it are inadmissible. Material admission remains a complete semantic commit or none.

grounding.quote:
Such a composite is not faithful; it is
adequate within its end-to-end bound and establishes nothing beyond that
bound.

constraints.statement: Faithful refinement requires exact steps, preserving interpreted meaning and Pᵢ→Pᵢ₊₁ without approximation; successful exact composition carries P₀→Pₙ by induction under its premises. An approximate step states adequacy to the exact result for the outer contract, and its composite states and argues an end-to-end departure bound. Such a composite is adequate only within that bound, not faithful, and establishes nothing beyond it. Fixed per-step tolerance does not itself compose into an end-to-end bound because deviations can accumulate. A step neither exact nor approximate with adequacy and composite bound is inadmissible; a dependent composite is neither faithful nor boundedly adequate.

conditions: A material transition is admitted.
exceptions: Established facts may be reused when exact subject, basis, scope, provenance and validity remain applicable and production/invalidation are recoverable.

grounding.quote:
Caller or
owner assertions of completeness, validity, prior admission or authority do
not establish truth.

Participating owners bind an equal basis or a
design-declared coherent composite basis; independently valid mixed-basis
judgments cannot combine

constraints.statement: Each owner derives and validates all relevant participants/equality joins and includes crossing far sides or authoritative nonparticipation. Caller/owner assertions are not truth. Reuse does not transfer responsibility, omit participants or satisfy separately required independent judgment. Mere function/component/role/conversation/status boundaries invalidate nothing and require no repeated derivation; mutation, rollback, changed authority/basis, expired validity and actual trust boundaries trigger validation before reliance/effect. Bind one exact admission-valid authoritative basis through commit; advancing currentness requires declared predecessor/currentness condition or effect-free re-entry. Owners use equal or design-declared coherent composite bases; independently valid incoherent mixed bases cannot combine. Validate every participant/join before any effect. No subset or nested constituent becomes admitted truth; failure/interruption admits all or none at every supported direct/composite/nested boundary. Partial results cannot replace owner derivation, and competing same-scope paths cannot admit outside the governing relation. Fresh reconstruction/replay on the same basis exactly reproduces relation, basis and complete outcome/refusal at semantic altitude. The law is false upon asserted rather than derived completeness, omitted participant/join/seam, unidentified/stale/incoherent basis, unguarded advancement, early effect, exposed subset, divergent reconstruction or competing same-scope authority.

conditions: Case lies within the accepted design's supported input, state and operating or threat model.
exceptions: Unsupported composite/nested forms receive design-grounded not_applicable with no weaker or competing path.
Representative atomic-failure observations suffice only under a design-declared dominance/equivalence proof covering the complete partial-failure surface.

grounding.quote:
Qualification of the admission law is instantiated for every admission
owner and supported boundary declared by accepted design (P6; provenance
rc.2 SPEC_METHOD #standing-structural-qualification). Case applicability
follows the supported input, state and operating or threat model. An
excluded threat alone cannot create an acceptance predicate or require
defensive work; a proposed scope expansion returns to its owning authority.
Supported malformed inputs, stale state and effect boundaries retain their
required checks:

| Form | Required observation |
|---|---|
| direct | the complete direct relation is derived, validated and admitted once |
| supported composite or nested | every supported constituent and owning boundary satisfies the same law; unsupported forms have a design-grounded `not_applicable` disposition and no weaker or competing path |
| forged | forged identity, membership, equality or authority reachable within the supported operating or threat model is refused without effect; exclusion requires its owning authority, not a helper's inability to construct the case |
| ambiguous enclosing relation | unresolved participant, join, seam or relation identity ambiguity is refused without effect |
| stale or advanced basis | stale input is refused, and basis advancement between preflight and admission causes effect-free re-entry rather than mixed-basis admission |
| incoherent multi-owner basis | owner judgments on bases that are neither equal nor joined by a design-declared coherent composite basis cannot combine and are refused without effect |
| competing same-scope admission authority | an undisposed competing same-scope path cannot establish the transition |
| reconstructed or fresh-process | the same basis reconstructs the same relation, basis identity and outcome or refusal |
| exact replay equality | replay over the same basis reproduces exactly the enclosing relation, basis identity and complete outcome or refusal |
| atomic publication failure | after validation succeeds, failure or interruption is observed at every materially distinct commit or publication boundary capable of exposing a subset, followed by fresh reconstruction showing the complete transition or none; named representative observations suffice only under a design-declared dominance or equivalence proof covering the complete partial-failure surface |

For an indivisible commit unit the atomic test establishes that boundary
and observes failure immediately on both sides. Final-participant
validation failure does not substitute for post-validation atomic-failure
evidence. A standing claim is false if an owner or supported boundary is
omitted, a materially distinct partial-failure boundary lacks an
observation or a declared coverage proof, a case uses a weaker helper or a
manufactured refusal, or fresh reconstruction does not compare the complete
semantic result (EVALUATION §1).

For an indivisible commit unit the atomic test establishes that boundary
and observes failure immediately on both sides. Final-participant
validation failure does not substitute for post-validation atomic-failure
evidence.

constraints.statement: Qualify every owner/supported boundary. Excluded threats alone create no acceptance predicate or defensive duty; scope expansion returns to owner, while supported malformed/stale/effect checks remain. Observe complete direct relation derived/validated/admitted once and the same law at each supported composite/nested constituent/owner. Refuse without effect supported reachable forged identity/membership/equality/authority, ambiguous participants/joins/seams/relation identity, and incoherent multi-owner bases; case exclusion requires owning authority, not helper inability. Refuse stale input; advancement between preflight/admission causes effect-free re-entry. Undisposed same-scope competitors cannot establish transition. Fresh-process reconstruction and exact replay compare complete relation, basis and outcome/refusal. After successful validation, observe failure/interruption at every materially distinct commit/publication boundary able to expose subsets, then reconstruct all-or-none. For an indivisible unit establish its boundary and fail immediately on both sides. Final-participant validation failure is no substitute. Standing is false for omitted owner/boundary, uncovered distinct failure boundary, weaker helper/manufactured refusal or incomplete semantic comparison.

grounding.quote:
A proposed restart, which reconstructs from less than the
retained work, identifies why repair of retained work is insufficient,
which obligations and evidence survive, and which causal assumptions
change; reconstructability alone does not select reconstruction.

constraints.statement: Resume from current material state, recover applicable progress, recheck each reused result's invalidators, reopen only affected support and reconcile uncertain external effects sufficiently before repetition/dependence. No blind retry follows from resumption; reconcile, yield or stop. Acceptance binds one exact checkpoint and allows only the next already-authorised bounded action without renewed human approval; it widens neither outcome nor affected set. A preservation checkpoint under existing exact operation grant identifies parent/predecessor, territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence location, without acceptance/promotion/publication. A restart from less retained work explains why repair is insufficient, surviving obligations/evidence and changed causal assumptions; reconstructability alone does not select it.

grounding.quote:
a category
it cannot map is a change to this owner, not a parallel category

The execution protocol of §1, §3 and this section is false if execution
proceeds from unreconstructable context

constraints.statement: Paperwork, code/test/commit/review counts are not progress by themselves. Consumers may derive projections, but finer categories must cite this owner and map each to progress, prerequisite work, evidence-not-new-progress, churn or forecast revision; unmappable categories require owner change. Execution protocol is false if context is unreconstructable, constructor report replaces required independent live evidence, proxy changes governance beyond delegation, unrelated incompleteness blocks a closed cone, same-process tests purport to prove materially cross-process authority, or rejected activity is reported as accepted progress.

grounding.quote: handoff is by closed results without private working context; reuse checks exact applicability and three invalidators, a material input change (newly acquired material evidence included), a changed basis and a declared revising observation, and a domain trigger is an instance of one of them; a reused judgment does not satisfy a required independent judgment

constraints.statement: Workspace is truth surface and actor context a disposable account: current evidence corrects the account and discarding it resets nothing. Recovery observations/reconciliation belong to the resuming intake with work state. Handoff uses closed results without private working context. Reuse checks exact applicability and three invalidators: material input change including newly acquired evidence, changed basis and declared revising observation; domain triggers instantiate them. Producers own revising observations and other invalidation conditions. Reused judgment does not satisfy required independent judgment. Reviewable transition names exact candidate, changes, proof and disposition; same-process proof does not establish reconstructable authority where losing process state is a counterexample.
constraints.uncertainty: Detailed workspace/account, closed-result and transition-evidence subsections are referenced but not supplied.

dispositions.reason: Retains member scope, imported ownership and provenance-only routing; unsupplied owned definitions remain explicit dependencies.
